title: Choose the visual world for Swarup Jewellers
question: The roll assigned The Lettered Jacket. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Lettered Jacket
options.lineage: Hand-lettered Calcutta book jackets and children's magazine covers, 1940s to 70s
options.thesis: Every page is a hand-lettered Bengali book jacket where the ornament's own name is the illustration.
materials: flat letterpress fields with slight misregistration
Bengali and Roman lettering locked together
options.viewport: After the entry story: a drenched turmeric jacket, the word সোনা in giant brush lettering with a bride's hands in sankha-pola drawn through it, today's rate as a printed price sticker, 'Find your piece' and WhatsApp on the jacket flap.
options.risk: Lettering-led pages look amateur unless spacing and drawn letterforms are crafted; few good Bengali display faces exist.

raised.raise: Every piece carries a stamped hallmark data line (purity, weight, rate date) so honest numbers get their own official voice.
Colour rationing: flat fields own whole regions; metallic gold appears only on what acts (enquire, active category, today's rate).
Today's rate steps digit by digit with one overshoot, never glides: the only kinetic number on the page.
Weights sit on a fixed gram ruler so pieces compare at a glance across a category.
The entry story runs as named cues (Mati, Agun, Haturi, Alta), each a full-colour field, skippable and scrubbable.
Total field commitment: product photos on red satin are matted onto the field as plates, never tinted.

options.label: The Pat Scroll
options.thesis: The site unrolls like a patua's scroll, one painted panel per stage of gold becoming a bride's ornament.
options.viewport: A vertical scroll panel: a painted bride wearing the newest Sankha, a border band of leaves, the shop's name lettered in the top band, WhatsApp as the singer's call.
options.risk: Folk-scroll heritage is where many Indian craft sites land, and it needs a large volume of real illustration to avoid clip-art.

options.label: Well-Traveled Passport
options.lineage: passport visa pages and entry stamps
options.thesis: Each piece as a stamped page in a booklet of identity.
options.viewport: A data page with the shop's details in OCR lines and stamps for each category.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Bengali families shopping for bridal gold don't see themselves in border control.
options.kept: The official data line: purity, weight and rate date stamped on every piece.
options.risk: Bureaucratic chill on an emotional purchase.

options.label: Rietveld Sliding House
options.thesis: Categories as sliding coloured planes that reconfigure one room.
options.viewport: Planes slide to reveal Sankha, Pola and Noa as rooms.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Dutch modernism has no claim on Bengali ornament; clarity holds but identity is lost.
options.kept: Colour rationed to the edges that move.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Categories roll past one window like a destination blind.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an operations metaphor for a showroom.
options.kept: Numbers step in whole units with one overshoot.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.thesis: Gold rate as a live trace on a graticule.
options.viewport: A green rate trace with readouts for purity and weight.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an instrument costume with no link to Bengali gold.
options.kept: Everything measured against one fixed scale.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: The story of gold as light rising from night to day.
options.viewport: A black stage with a cobalt band rising behind a single necklace.
options.case: Fuses moderately but generically: atmosphere without Bengali identity, and the products recede.
options.kept: Named story cues that are skippable and scrubbable.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: Everything flattened under one amber sun.
options.viewport: A half sun with the ornament's silhouette mirrored above.
options.case: Fuses poorly: amber duotone would destroy the product photography.
options.kept: Total commitment to one colour per field.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The national-chain jeweller look, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed bridal photo carousel, serif headline, category tiles below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other jeweller by design.
